name: California AB 2013 (AI Training Data Transparency)

use_case_categories: Generative AI systems available to California residents
scope.description: Applies to developers of generative AI systems or services available to Californians.

requirements.obligation: Post high-level summary of training data on developer website
Include data sources, types, and whether personal information or copyrighted material was used

ai_risk_tier: Maps to GAIF Medium for generative AI transparency

disclosure_requirements: Training data summary on developer website
AI-BOM Data_P must include sources and data types
monitoring_requirements: Update training data summary when training data changes
